description: This is a test class for the LocationValidator, containing unit tests for validating Location objects in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: LocationValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit Jupiter test class for testing Location validation logic within OpenMRS.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the Location's name is null or empty.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredAndRetireReasonIsNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if Location is retired but no retire reason is provided.

methods.name: validate_shouldSetRetiredToFalseIfRetireReasonIsNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Checks that an invalid retire reason results in the Location's 'retired' status being set to false.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllFieldsAreCorrect
methods.description: Validates that a fully correct Location passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfRetiredLocationIsGivenRetiredReason
methods.description: Ensures a retired Location with a valid retire reason passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfParentLocationCreatesALoop
methods.description: Tests that cyclic parent location references are flagged as errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfLocationNameAlreadyExist
methods.description: Checks validation failure for duplicate Location names.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Validates that fields within acceptable length pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Ensures overly long field values trigger validation errors.
